document_capture_note: City guides/profile/FAQ PDFs retain their own source capture timestamps, compiled2026-10-27.
notes: This is a captured public travel snapshot, not current availability or a booking promise.
30 cases:6 document,5 SQL,5 SQL+calculation,4 actual multi-turn blended,6 insufficiency/ambiguity,2 security groups(4 SQL injections),2 controlled failures.
Expected values are offline evaluator data only; runtime ingests JSONL and PDFs and never imports this bundle.
Canonical amounts are integer IRR; expected calculator values explicitly marked Toman. Decimal Toman values are preserved.
SQL equivalence uses row/number/identity evidence, not exact SQL strings or answer phrasing. Ranking includes explicit tie-breakers.
All live requests are attempted once. A mechanical pass does not establish semantic faithfulness; human review remains required.
Retrieval challenge tags select12 identical questions per mode; Recall/MRR/any/all gold coverage are reported separately from endpoint execution success.
Conversation tests send only user turns and the actual preceding assistant answer plus validated state; no expected slots/prices are supplied.
